description: This is a test class for the ConceptNameSaveHandler class in the OpenMRS API project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of the handle method, especially how it manages ConceptNameTag instances associated with ConceptName objects.

classes.name: ConceptNameSaveHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ConceptNameSaveHandler, verifying handling of ConceptNameTag IDs during save operations.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotFailIfTagsIsNull
methods.description: Tests that handle method does not throw an exception when ConceptName's tags are null.

methods.name: handle_shouldReplaceTagsWithoutIdsWithDatabaseFetchedTag
methods.description: Verifies that tags without IDs are replaced with database-fetched tags and assigned correct IDs.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotReplaceTagsWithoutIdsThatAreNotInTheDatabase
methods.description: Ensures that tags without IDs and not present in the database are left unchanged.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotReplaceTagsThatHaveIds
methods.description: Checks that tags with existing IDs are preserved without modification.
